title: Lesson 5: Where Are You?
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/lets-learn-english-lesson-5-where-are-you/3168971.html

sentences.text: Today my friend Marcia is at her friend's house.
She says it is beautiful.
I want to see this house Here we are Marcia, I am in the kitchen.
It is a beautiful kitchen It is Beautiful we cook in the kitchen.
I eat in the kitchen We relax in the living room.
I Relax in the living room Marcia, let's go upstairs.
I am in the living room.
I Relax in the living room Now you try it.
Are you Marcia?
I am in the bathroom.
I wash in the bathroom I am in the bedroom We sleep in the bedroom.
I Sleep in the bedroom We sleep in the bedroom.
I Wash in the bathroom Now you try it.
Say where you are.
Hello, everyone Today my friend Marcia is at her friend's house.
She says it is beautiful.
I Want to see this house Here we are Marcia, I am in the kitchen.
It is a beautiful kitchen It is beautiful.
We cook in the kitchen.
I Eat in the kitchen We relax in the living room.
I Relax in the living room Marcia, let's go upstairs Marcia, I am in the bathroom.
I wash in the bathroom.
I am in the bedroom We sleep in the bedroom.
I Sleep in the bedroom To ask a question use a rising tone of voice Anna Where are you?
A statement with a rising tone becomes a question You are in the kitchen.
Now you try it.
Say you are in the living room with rising intonation Questions can change word order Are you in the kitchen?
Now you try it.
Make your voice go up at the end We
usually use a preposition like in with a location Some locations like upstairs have no preposition.
I am upstairs.
I am in the kitchen Now you try it
